title: Gopalan–Servedio square-root-degree Fourier bound
exact_target: Is there an absolute constant C such that every nonconstant Boolean $f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}$ satisfies $sum_i$ $|f_hat({i})|<=C$ sqrt(deg(f)), where deg(f) is its exact real multilinear degree?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
Is there an absolute constant C such that every nonconstant Boolean $f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}$ satisfies $sum_i$ $|f_hat({i})|<=C$ sqrt(deg(f)), where deg(f) is its exact real multilinear degree?

\subsection{Short English statement}
Is there an absolute constant C such that every nonconstant Boolean $f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}$ satisfies $sum_i$ $|f_hat({i})|<=C$ sqrt(deg(f)), where deg(f) is its exact real multilinear degree?
